requirement: The annex is broadly unchanged since Ed1, with minor clarifications and alignment to Annex T

Annex D shall (1) requires this interface or Annex T, but the main body allows other mechanisms and Annex C says no interface is specified or required. Our reading: use our own modem port and keep the Annex D rules that make sense without a serial line (no gaps between D_PDUs, EOT covers post-fill, receiver sync search)

With a modem port there are no post-fill characters as such. Our reading: anything the modem sends after the last D_PDU (EOM, flush, padding to the end of the last interleaver block) counts as post-fill, so EOT is computed from the modem's planned burst end
notes: Plan 5.4: EOT from PlanBurst including flush

requirement: Annex J says Annex K adds requirements to Annex D for listen-before-transmit, and Annex K takes DCD from the communications equipment interface, but Annex D defines no DCD or carrier signal. Our reading: DCD comes from the modem port burst start and end events (plus the optional external busy input, plan 7.3); nothing is added to an Annex D interface
